children: Nillion schedules a supply unlock for December 2026 under the circulation plan the project filed with Upbit. The planned release covers up to 20.32 million NIL, an amount equal to 3.38% of the token's circulating supply.
The unlock makes the released NIL available to trade. Holders gain access to more tokens they can sell on the market once those tokens are unlocked.

title: Nillion: Unlocks up to 20.32 million NIL - Dec 2026
